build_graph_attention_data: build a GraphAttentionData object from AtomicData by preprocessing molecular graphs with radius graph and edge expansions
create_edge_distance_expansion: create edge distance expansion features using Gaussian, Sigmoid, or SiLU smearing functions on edge distances
compute_frequency_vectors: compute frequency vectors for neighbor attention by calculating spherical harmonics on edge direction vectors
calculate_bond_orientational_order: calculate Bond-Orientational Order for each node using spherical harmonics and neighbor direction vectors
pad_and_unpad_batch: pad batch tensors to fixed size for torch.compile compatibility and unpad results after model inference
